get.description: Returns store-level cart availability grouped by store. Distances are in the metric system (m).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The list of the requested product ids separated by a comma

parameters.name: idType
parameters.description: The type of the unique product identifier (default - MikMak default Product Id, gtin, mpn, product_id). (eg: gtin)

parameters.name: wtbId
parameters.description: The experience id

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: True to use the draft experience configuration

parameters.name: maxDistance
parameters.description: Max search distance (radius) in km, this parameter can override subaccount default setting

parameters.name: maxReturnedStores
parameters.description: Maximum number of returned stores

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Requested language or locale for the product and retailers

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Search location latitude (any combination of Latitude + Longitude OR ZipCode + Country must be provided)

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Search location longitude (any combination of Latitude + Longitude OR ZipCode + Country must be provided)

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Search location country code (2-letters)  (any combination of Latitude + Longitude OR ZipCode + Country must be provided)

parameters.name: zipCode
parameters.description: Search location zip code (any combination of Latitude + Longitude OR ZipCode + Country must be provided)

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Search location city

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Search location address

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Search location state

parameters.name: requestedCountry
parameters.description: Requested country code (2-letters). Only for multiple countries experience. If the location country is different from the requestedCountry, the location falls back to default location for the requested country.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Id for the current session so the events can be properly tracked.

parameters.name: currentUrl
parameters.description: The full URL visible in the shopper's browser as they interact with the Experience. It must include all query parameters. This is necessary to report on UTM parameters.

parameters.name: sessionUrl
parameters.description: The full URL visible in the shopper's browser when they first arrived on the website. This has to be persisted throughout the session. It must include all query parameters. This is necessary to report on UTM parameters.

parameters.name: includeOutOfStock
parameters.description: True to include out of stock products

parameters.name: hideOutOfStockOfflineStores
parameters.description: True to hide out of stock offline stores

parameters.name: applyTiedHouseLaw
parameters.description: To override the experience setting for applying tied house law

parameters.name: retailerIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of retailer IDs to filter availability results. Only stores from the specified retailers will be returned. If omitted, all in-scope retailers are returned.

parameters.name: modes
parameters.description: Delivery mode filter (delivery, clickAndCollect, brickAndMortar). Filters availability results to only include stores that support the specified delivery modes

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source identifier for tracking where the request originated from

parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: Instance identifier for multi-tenant or distributed system tracking

carts.description: One entry per store with aggregated cart totals and per-line availability

applyTiedHouseLaw.description: Whether to apply tied house law

totalPrice.description: Total cart price for this store

totalQuantity.description: Sum of line quantities across products in this cart

availableProducts.description: Count of products available at this store

requestedProducts.description: Count of requested products considered for this store

availabilities.description: Line items per product at this store

valueWithVoucher.description: Unit price after voucher when applicable

clickUrl.description: Tracked click URL for this line
